cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
The Nash Bach Bash is designed to recognize your bride or groom. It's a celebratory party atmosphere as much as it is a fun line dance lesson. You'll dance, you'll party, you'll scoot your boots and love every second. Your bride will receive a souvenir wristlet to remember the experience.

The dances taught are typically beginner level and easy to learn. The instruction is mixed with jokes and humor so it's light and fun which makes learning easier.

There is plenty of time for photos or videos throughout the event so you can remember the amazing time you had with your friends and family. Phone tripods are also provided if you'd like to record your group performing the dances and looking fire!
